description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithEmployeeString' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface, and provides a method to return a fixed string 'Employee' regardless of input. It is part of a human resource management system, specifically within the 'orangehrmMaintenancePlugin' plugin's 'PurgeStrategy/FormatValue' component.

classes.name: FormatWithEmployeeString
classes.description: A formatter class that returns the string 'Employee' for any given input, implementing the ValueFormatter interface.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the fixed string 'Employee' regardless of the provided entity value.
